none: PAS LON-78FFF7: Roman copper alloy coin: nummus from the House of Constantine
contea di ritrovamento: Essex (Inghilterra e Galles)

A Roman copper alloy coin: nummus from the House of Constantine dating AD330-335. Mint: Trier. Reverse: Victory on prow with sceptre and shield. Reece period 17. Obverse: Helmeted, cuirassed and draped bust left. Obverse inscription: [CONSTAN]TINOPOLIS. Reverse: Victory on prow with sceptre and shield, symbol of the new Constantinople, New Rome. Reverse inscription: None. Mint mark: -/-//TR[-]. Die axis measurement: 12.00. Dimensions: diameter: 16.25mm; weight: 1.96g
